notes: Single real measurement for the candle-metal lane. NOT enough points to fit a_candle_metal (fit_a_lane requires two distinct tokens_per_step values at the same model shape). See crates/vox-populi/src/mens/tensor/calibration.rs test `single_real_candle_metal_point_refuses_to_fit` and docs/src/architecture/measurements/2026-09-11-candle-metal-calibration.md for the full story, including the preset_schema.rs batch-size-flooring bug this measurement surfaced.

records.artifact_bytes_note: approximate: 0.6B params x 2 bytes/param (bf16), from the published model card; not independently measured in this run. artifact_bytes is not consumed by fit_a_lane or best_record, so this approximation does not affect either.
records.tokens_per_step_note: actual measured shape was batch=2 x seq=512, not the requested batch=1 x seq=512 -- see preset_schema.rs bug writeup
